title: Nested Theme Maps
prompt: Represent light and dark theme values with nested maps, then emit CSS custom properties so a browser can switch themes at runtime.

starter.code:
$themes: (light: (surface: #fff, text: #172033), dark: (surface: #172033, text: #f8fafc));
@each $name, $theme in $themes { [data-theme="#{$name}"] { --surface: #{map.get($theme, surface)}; --text: #{map.get($theme, text)}; } }

public_tests.name: Expected behavior
public_tests.note: This starter grader checks required terms only; compile and inspect the real CSS before considering the work correct.

expected_output: Both theme blocks are emitted with CSS custom properties. Changing data-theme changes the runtime values without recompiling Sass.
